input_law: all 1722 ordered distinct nonidentity source pairs, selecting the 336 with distinct rational x coordinates and x collision at 7 or 11; the reduced-relation flag is excluded from decisions
collision_priority: 7 before 11 when both auxiliary x coordinates collide
local_policy: at the collision prime enumerate all compatible a1,a2,a3,a4 residues with a6 from the first point; at the other prime use the original distinct-x two-point incidence rule; retain nonsingular curves of order 4 at 7 and order 6 at 11
crt_policy: for each ordered pair of local witnesses choose centered k1,k2,k3 modulo 77 with ai=47ki; correct one lexicographically first effective ki by a centered multiple of 77 to match the collision-prime a4 residue; retain one corrected rational curve per local pair
local_correction: the change in rational a4 modulo the collision prime is measured exactly for each unit shift, choosing the first nonzero slope; if all slopes vanish, retain the centered representative only when already matched
checks: exact rational point incidence, local coefficient residues and orders, rational discriminant, rational P1+2P2 relation; source reduced relation for analysis only
record: all 336 selected pair statuses, every constructed candidate in deterministic compressed rows, every rational relation, source and candidate digests, cap and wall states
null: rational relation rate under the same centered CRT policy on the 1344 locally distinct-x source pairs, 8/32256; no conditional rate is promoted to an algorithmic win
decision: report complete count and exact rate if uncensored; otherwise report observed counts with cap and unknown full rate; compare with the prior 8/32256 construction rate without a speedup claim
claim_boundary: target-independent curve-selection diagnostic, with no scalar recovery or rho timing; local collisions and one extra CRT digit only
